Title: Generally available: Azure Stream Analytics in seven more regions

Body.Content:
Azure Stream Analytics is now generally available in seven more regions:

  • Italy North
  • Poland Central
  • Qatar Central
  • Brazil Southeast
  • Israel Central
  • Spain Central
  • Mexico Central

With this announcement, Stream Analytics is now available in 60 Azure regions worldwide. For more information about local pricing, visit the Azure Stream Analytics pricing webpage.
